entries.title: Bulk-apply permissions across events
entries.summary: copy custom roles, field visibility and locking, and team role assignments from one template event to up to 250 events from **Org Settings > Bulk Permissions**, preview every change per event, and apply it as a background run recorded in each event's History.

entries.title: Limit which session statuses a role can set
entries.summary: a new **Statuses** tab on each custom role chooses which statuses its members can move a session into; their status pickers offer only those, and refused changes name the status.

entries.title: Color agenda cards by tags
entries.summary: coloring the agenda by **Tags** now keeps cards white with a small colored square per tag, so sessions with several tags show all of them, in the calendar, the sidebar, and while dragging.

entries.title: Right-to-left embeds
entries.summary: agenda, schedule, session and speaker embeds rendered in Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, or another right-to-left language are laid out right to left.

entries.title: Reset the export date format to its default
entries.summary: **Export date format** can be set back to **System default** in Org Settings > Details, or to **Organization default** on an event, after a specific format has been saved.

entries.title: Turn off the Visit consent gate
entries.summary: the Visit consent picker has a **None — do not require consent** option, so a saved consent gate can be switched off.

entries.title: Community: ideas, roadmap and what's new inside Sessionboard
entries.summary: vote on and submit product ideas, follow the roadmap and read product updates from **Community** in the sidebar, and get notified when an idea you voted for moves or ships. It replaces the old feedback board, with every idea, vote and comment carried over.

entries.title: Turn on Content Galleries yourself, for the organization or one event
entries.summary: Content Galleries is now a self-serve Early Access Preview: switch it on org-wide from **Org → Early Access**, or for a single event from that event's Early Access page.
